name: tile-overlay
title: Tile Overlay
description: The one visual recipe for media tiles — the photo scrim, the blurred-scrim overlay button, the top-left and top-right overlay slots that show on hover or focus, and the responsive at-most-N-per-row tile grid — shared by Attachment, SortableList and AvatarPicker.

meta.whenToUse: Building a tile surface with controls over an image — spread tileCornerClasses on the slot, tileOverlayButtonClasses on a ghost icon Button, tileGroupClass on the tile.
meta.whenNotToUse: Chrome that does not sit over media — use a plain Button.
